evidence: Modifies ConnectBlock script verification dispatch, CheckInputScripts signature, and script execution caching in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: The PR unifies block script checking paths in ConnectBlock and fixes an inconsistency where script execution caching during TestBlockValidity was bypassed when multithreading. It removes dual-mode execution branches and prepares validation code for batch verification follow-up work (#29491), but represents an internal refactor rather than an urgent correctness or consensus bug fix.
